<tr class="re">
<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_hvpd_RevolvingCreditFacilityTextBlock', window );">Revolving Credit Facility</a></td>
<td class="text"><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 18pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">6. Revolving Credit Facility </div></div><div style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0px; top: 0px;display:inline;">On June&#160;24, 2026, the Aggregator, entered into a revolving credit agreement (the &#8220;Revolving Credit Facility&#8221;) with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. The amount of the Revolving Credit Facility is $75&#160;million. The Revolving Credit Facility has an interest rate at Adjusted Term SOFR Rate plus the 2.80% per annum and a facility fee of 1.20% per annum on the unused amount of the facility. The Revolving Credit Facility matures on June&#160;23, 2028. The Aggregator has established the Revolving Credit Facility to borrow money for a range of purposes, including for the purpose of funding investments, to manage timing issues in connection with the inflows of additional capital and to otherwise satisfy its liabilities or obligations, or for investment purposes. Borrowings on the Revolving Credit Facility are secured by a pledge of certain accounts of the Aggregator and proceeds from those accounts. As of June&#160;30, 2026, the Aggregator had no borrowings or amounts outstanding under the Revolving Credit Facility. </div></div><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
